projects.title: Healthcare Claims Data Warehouse and ETL Mapping
projects.description:
Architected a Medicare claims data warehouse consolidating source systems and file specifications, building ETL mappings and BI report specifications that reduced requirements validation effort by 40% across a 4-sprint Agile cycle.
Authored test plans and traceability matrices covering 130+ source-to-target fields, validated through SQL-based test data creation and verification queries, reaching UAT sign-off with zero critical defects.
Facilitated structured requirements workshops across data subject areas, analyzing entity relationship diagrams and database models to produce a phased ETL work breakdown structure.

projects.title: Retail Insights
projects.description: Analytics-engineering project on 541,909 real UK e-commerce transactions: a tested, documented dbt star schema feeding cohort retention, RFM segmentation, and window-function SQL, surfaced in an executive dashboard. Every metric is produced by dbt build with 79 passing tests — the engineering behind the numbers, not just a chart.

projects.title: Sales Insights — Tableau & SQL
projects.description: Business-intelligence analysis for an India-based hardware company: built SQL ETL mappings to extract and stage data for cleaning, designed a star-schema data model, and delivered a Tableau dashboard surfacing the parameters driving company performance and data-driven business decisions.

projects.title: Supply Chain Analysis — FMCG (AtliQ Mart)
projects.description: Supply-chain service-level analysis for FMCG manufacturer AtliQ Mart: built Power BI metrics for On-Time (OT%), In-Full (IF%), and On-Time-In-Full (OTIF%) delivery performance against per-customer targets, with a stakeholder dashboard and additional insights to help fix service issues before market expansion.

projects.title: Uber Trip Analysis — Power BI
projects.description: Power BI dashboard analyzing a month of Uber trip data — total bookings, booking value, trip distance and time — across Overview, Time-Series, and Details views to reveal booking trends, customer behavior, revenue generation, and operational efficiency.

projects.title: F1 Data Analysis — SQL & Tableau
projects.description: Formula 1 analytics spanning 1953–2020: a relational SQL database of race results, driver and team statistics, and circuit details, queried for performance and historical-trend insights and visualized through interactive Tableau dashboards.

projects.title: Healthcare Data Analysis — Power BI
projects.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard on hospital visitor data using DAX and Power Query to surface patient demographics and service-usage KPIs, supporting resource optimization and improved patient-care quality through business intelligence.

projects.title: U.S. Healthcare Industry Analysis — Power BI
projects.description: Multi-page Power BI analysis of U.S. healthcare industry dynamics from 2019 to 2020, presenting industry KPIs and insights across the evolving healthcare landscape through an interactive published dashboard.

projects.title: SQL for Financial Data Analysis
projects.description: A SQL-based financial reporting and analysis system over five datasets — general ledger, chart of accounts, territory, calendar, and cash flow — generating Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow statements through pivot-style reporting queries.

projects.title: Finances Database
projects.description: Personal-finance analytics project that builds a SQL database from raw transactions, layers reporting views on top, and surfaces spending and cash-flow trends in a dashboard.

projects.title: Log Analysis & Anomaly Detection
projects.description: A log-analysis and anomaly-detection system that parses logs with regular expressions, extracts features, and uses an Isolation Forest model to flag unusual patterns that may indicate security threats, with real-time monitoring and visualization.
